title: Create a @taucad/* package
description: Scaffolds a publishable @taucad/* package with an ESM-only build, vitest, and all Tau conventions.

name.x-prompt: What is the package name (without @taucad/ prefix)?

description.description: Package description for package.json and README

scope.description: Placement, which derives tags, privacy, and build defaults (packages for publishable surfaces, libs for shared capabilities, apps/libs for private application capabilities, tools for private dev-time-only tooling)

layer.description: Required architecture layer for apps/libs projects

react.description: Configure React peers, JSX, jsdom, and Testing Library

build.description: Emit tsdown build configuration (defaults to false for apps/libs and true otherwise)
